LanguageData.LP_WoodElf.label: wood elf
LanguageData.LP_WoodElf.description: An elven subrace living deep in ancient forests; the bloodline is passed on to children. Brownish skin, dark brown or fiery red hair, light on their feet, good at archery and tending plants; like other elves they sleep little, age extremely slowly after adulthood and are strong-minded, and are just as fragile. Wood elves dislike poring over books and research more slowly.
LanguageData.LP_WoodElf.descriptionShort: Inheritable elven subrace. Strong shooting and plants, fast; sleeps little, ages extremely slowly, high mind resistance; fragile, weak melee, slow research.
LanguageData.LP_Drow.label: drow
LanguageData.LP_Drow.description: An elven subrace that climbed up from the Underdark; the bloodline is passed on to children. Dark grey or purple-black skin, snow-white hair, sees in the dark, psychically sensitive, good at melee; their blades are often coated with spider queen venom, and they can call magical darkness by birth. Drow fear light: they can't stand ultraviolet light, and their hit chance drops outdoors by day. Drow and surface elves have been enemies for generations.
LanguageData.LP_Drow.descriptionShort: Inheritable elven subrace. Strong melee, night vision, psychically sensitive, melee occasionally poisons, can cast darkness; light-sensitive, lower hit chance outdoors by day; mutually hostile with other elves.
LanguageData.LP_HillDwarf.label: hill dwarf
LanguageData.LP_HillDwarf.description: A dwarf subrace living in hills and low mountains; the bloodline is passed on to children. Like mountain dwarves: short, stocky, bearded, able to see in the dark, born miners and craftsmen; especially strong immunity and extra-sturdy flesh and bones, so each part can take a few more hits. Dwarves never get addicted to alcohol, are happier inside the mountain, and never forget a blood debt.
LanguageData.LP_HillDwarf.descriptionShort: Inheritable dwarf subrace. Strong at mining and crafting, sturdy, strong immunity, part health ×115%, night vision; slow, small; holds grudges.
LanguageData.LP_HalflingLightfoot.label: lightfoot halfling
LanguageData.LP_HalflingLightfoot.description: A halfling subrace that loves to travel; the bloodline is passed on to children. Only 70% as tall as others, fast runners, good at farming, cooking and socializing, pleasant-looking and optimistic by nature; big appetites and get hungry fast. Halflings are brave and lucky: they never panic and flee, and a lethal blow sometimes only grazes them. Lightfoots are light of build and take worse injuries, but are good at hiding behind big folk.
LanguageData.LP_HalflingLightfoot.descriptionShort: Inheritable small race. Fast, strong at plants, cooking and social, optimistic and good-looking; brave, lucky, hides behind big folk; big appetite, fragile body.
LanguageData.LP_HalflingStout.label: stout halfling
LanguageData.LP_HalflingStout.description: A halfling subrace said to carry dwarven blood; the bloodline is passed on to children. Like lightfoots: small, fast, good at farming and cooking, cheerful, brave and lucky; stouts are rounder and sturdier, poison-resistant with strong immunity, just a little slower and fonder of sleeping in.
LanguageData.LP_HalflingStout.descriptionShort: Inheritable small race. Fast, strong at plants and cooking, optimistic; brave, lucky, poison-resistant, strong immunity; big appetite, sleepy.
LanguageData.LP_RockGnome.label: rock gnome
LanguageData.LP_RockGnome.description: A gnome subrace living in the hills; the bloodline is passed on to children. Only 60% as tall as others, pointy-eared optimists who learn extremely fast and excel at research and crafting; born inventors; cunning of mind and hard to affect with psychic effects. Gnomes are weak, poor at melee, and short-legged, so they walk slowly.
LanguageData.LP_RockGnome.descriptionShort: Inheritable small race. Strong Intellectual and Crafting, quick learners, optimistic, mind resistance +60%; weak melee, slow.
LanguageData.LP_ForestGnome.label: forest gnome
LanguageData.LP_ForestGnome.description: A gnome subrace that lives hidden in the woods; the bloodline is passed on to children. Like rock gnomes: clever, cheerful, quick learners and cunning of mind; forest gnomes are good with animals, can talk to small animals and tame them especially easily. Gnomes are weak, poor at melee and slow.
LanguageData.LP_ForestGnome.descriptionShort: Inheritable small race. Strong Intellectual and Animals, quick learners, can talk with small animals; mind resistance +60%; weak melee, slow.
LanguageData.LP_DeepGnome.label: deep gnome
LanguageData.LP_DeepGnome.description: A gnome subrace of the Underdark; the bloodline is passed on to children. Skin grey as rock, mostly bald; sees in the dark, can't stand ultraviolet light well; nearly indistinguishable from stone when motionless. Like other gnomes: clever, cheerful, quick learners and cunning of mind, weak and slow.
LanguageData.LP_DeepGnome.descriptionShort: Inheritable small race. Strong Intellectual, quick learners, night vision, stone camouflage when still; mind resistance +60%; mildly light-sensitive, weak melee, slow.
LanguageData.LP_HalfElf.label: half-elf
LanguageData.LP_HalfElf.description: The mixed offspring of humans and elves; the bloodline is passed on to children. Pointed ears, pleasant looks, natural people persons; they inherit a little elven longevity and steadfastness of mind. Half-elves are versatile: each is born with two different random skill talents (selectable in the gene editor). In a colony with a half-elf, elves and dwarves quarrel less.
LanguageData.LP_HalfElf.descriptionShort: Inheritable mixed race. Strong Social, good-looking, two random skill talents, ages more slowly, mind resistance +25%; eases friction between elves and dwarves.
LanguageData.LP_Kobold.label: kobold
LanguageData.LP_Kobold.description: Small reptilian humanoids who claim descent from dragons; the bloodline is passed on to children. Red-brown or blue-grey scaly skin, short tails, small horns, only 60% as tall as others; good at mining and crafting, born trapmakers who swarm together in fights. Kobolds see in the dark but can't stand ultraviolet light; fragile, weak and not pleasant to look at. They worship dragons and are full of drive when the colony has one.
LanguageData.LP_Kobold.descriptionShort: Inheritable small race. Strong at mining and crafting, night vision, trapmakers, pack tactics, serve dragons; light-sensitive, fragile, low melee damage, ugly.
LanguageData.LP_Goblin.label: goblin
LanguageData.LP_Goblin.description: Small humanoids that roam in packs; the bloodline is passed on to children. Green skin, pointed ears, only 60% as tall as others, fast runners who see in the dark; they flee when hit and hate being looked down on by big folk. Goblins are ugly, weak, poor at socializing and have no artistic bone in their bodies.
LanguageData.LP_Goblin.descriptionShort: Inheritable small race. Fast, night vision, flee faster after being hit, +15% damage against bigger targets; ugly, low melee damage, poor at social and art.
LanguageData.LP_Hobgoblin.label: hobgoblin
LanguageData.LP_Hobgoblin.description: Disciplined goblinoid warriors; the bloodline is passed on to children. Orange-red skin, pointed ears, about human size; good at shooting, hot-tempered, see in the dark. Hobgoblins value battle formations: the more companions around them, the better they fight, and they never have mental breaks while drafted.
LanguageData.LP_Hobgoblin.descriptionShort: Inheritable goblinoid. Strong shooting, night vision, higher hit chance and work speed with companions nearby, no breaks while drafted; hot-tempered.
LanguageData.LP_Bugbear.label: bugbear
LanguageData.LP_Bugbear.description: The tallest branch of the goblinoids; the bloodline is passed on to children. Hairy all over, broad-shouldered, with unusually long arms; high melee damage and accuracy, best at ambushing from the dark; but slow learners and sleepy.
LanguageData.LP_Bugbear.descriptionShort: Inheritable goblinoid. Burly, furred, high melee damage, long arms give +10% melee hit, ambush damage ×125%; slow learners, sleepy.
